name: Bloody Skeletal Champion Advanced Hound Archon
body:
Bloody Skeletal Champion Advanced Hound Archon CR 8

XP 4,800
NE Medium augmented undead (extraplanar)

Init +6; Senses darkvision 60 ft., detect evil, low-light vision, scent; Perception +15
Aura aura of menace (DC 19), magic circle against evil

DEFENSE

AC 25, touch 12, flat-footed 25 (+13 natural, +2 Dex; +2 deflection vs. evil)
hp 55 (10d8+10) fast healing 5
Fort +8, Ref +7, Will +9; +4 vs. poison, +2 resistance vs. evil
Defensive Abilities channel resistance +4, DR 10/evil and bludgeoning; Immune cold, electricity, petrification, undead traits; SR 15

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee bite +11 (1d8+4), 2 claws +11 (1d4+4)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 10th)

Constant—detect evil, magic circle against evil
At Will—aid, continual flame, greater teleport (self plus 50 lbs. of objects only), message

STATISTICS

Str 19, Dex 14, Con –, Int 13, Wis 15, Cha 16
Base Atk +7; CMB +11; CMD 23
Feats Great Fortitude, Improved Initiative, Multiattack, Lightning Reflexes, Power Attack, Toughness
Skills Intimidate +16, Perception +15, Sense Motive +15, Stealth +19, Survival +16; Racial Modifiers +4 Stealth, +4 Survival
Languages understands (but cannot speak) Celestial, Draconic, Infernal; truespeech, Abyssal
SQ change shape (beast shape II), deathless

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization Unique
Treasure standard

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Change Shape (Su)

A hound archon can assume any canine form of Small to Large size, as if using beast shape II. While in canine form, the hound archon loses its bite and claw attacks, but gains the bite attack of the form it chooses.

For the purposes of this ability, canines include any dog-like or wolf-like creature of the animal type.

Deathless (Su)

A bloody skeleton is destroyed when reduced to 0 hit points, but it returns to unlife 1 hour later at 1 hit point, allowing its fast healing thereafter to resume healing it. A bloody skeleton can be permanently destroyed if it is destroyed by positive energy, if it is reduced to 0 hit points in the area of a bless or hallow spell, or if its remains are sprinkled with a vial of holy water.

Undead Traits (Ex)

Undead are immune to death effects, disease, mind-affecting effects (charms, compulsions, morale effects, phantasms, and patterns), paralysis, poison, sleep, stun, and any effect that requires a Fortitude save (unless the effect also works on objects or is harmless). Undead are not subject to ability drain, energy drain, or nonlethal damage. Undead are immune to damage or penalties to their physical ability scores (Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution), as well as to fatigue and exhaustion effects. Undead are not at risk of death from massive damage.

ABOUT

The Bloody Hound is capable of assuming the form of any canine-like animal from Small to Large size.

Dog Form

The Bloody Hound uses the dog form to look like a harmless stray. It can enter villages and cities when hunting and if it needs to get into small spaces or hide.

In combat, the dog form boasts the highest AC, fastest initiative highest Reflex save, and has the highest Stealth score.

Wolf Form

Because humans hesitate to approach a larger dog or wolf in a civilized setting and this makes The Bloody Hound is less noticeable in the wilderness in this form than a dire wolf. In combat, the wolf form is faster than the dog form and it enjoys a slightly higher CMB and CMD.

Dire Wolf Form

The Bloody Hound is large and imposing in dire wolf form and can get work done without alerting local clerics that an undead creature is near.

In combat, the dire wolf form is faster than the dog form and enjoys a higher CMB and CMD than the wolf or the dog. The dire wolf form also does the most amount of damage.

The dire wolf form has a good chance to trip opponents, but suffers the lowest Reflex save and Stealth of all its forms.
